long_biography.plain_text:
Coffee businessman Marco Lavazza first learned his way around the company by delivering post during school holidays. At twelve, he carried letters between employees after his father decided that summer should include some work. The rounds introduced him to the people and departments behind the family name.

Lavazza's approach to coffee blends accommodates different national tastes rather than prescribing a single ideal espresso. The company samples coffees from several producing countries and combines them for different markets. Professional training centres teach bar staff, while online lessons and packaging links give home customers instructions for making coffee.
